2609.38434.title: TACIT: Optimization Models that Learn from Their Mistakes
2609.38434.paper_summary: Real-world optimization problems are difficult to model accurately because many objectives and constraints reside in domain experts' tacit knowledge, making them hard to formalize. As a result, optimization models often contain miscalibrated objectives, missing constraints, or omitted decision variables, leading to solutions that fail to reflect operational realities. We address this challenge by automatically repairing misspecified formulations using historical data consisting of past solutions and subsequent user overrides. Traditional approaches such as inverse optimization and constraint learning tend to overfit sparse data and produce complex formulations. Our central idea is to combine the reasoning capabilities and prior knowledge of LLMs with the formal grounding provided by optimization. We realize this idea through two complementary paradigms. Top-down, an LLM proposes structural repairs, including new constraints and variables, whose numerical parameters are calibrated and validated through optimization. Bottom-up, optimization infers cuts from observed decisions, which the LLM contextualizes into interpretable, generalizable modeling constraints. We evaluate our approach on 38 misspecification scenarios spanning nine classes of optimization problems, several drawn from real-world applications, and show that TACIT can repair 78.9% of them (vs. 60.5% for the best baseline).
2609.38434.paper_summary_zh: 現實世界中的優化問題難以準確建模，因為許多目標和約束存在於領域專家的隱性知識中，使其難以形式化。<lb/>因此，優化模型通常包含錯誤調校的目標、缺失的約束或省略的決策變數，導致解決方案無法反映操作現實。<lb/>我們通過使用包含過去解決方案和隨後用戶覆蓋的歷史數據，自動修復錯誤指定的公式來應對這一挑戰。<lb/>傳統方法如反向優化和約束學習往往會對稀疏數據過擬合，並產生複雜的公式。<lb/>我們的核心思想是將大型語言模型（LLMs）的推理能力和先驗知識與優化提供的正式基礎相結合。<lb/>我們通過兩種互補的範式實現這一思想。<lb/>自上而下，LLM 提出結構修復，包括新的約束和變數，其數值參數通過優化進行調校和驗證。<lb/>自下而上，優化從觀察到的決策中推斷切割，LLM 將其上下文化為可解釋的、可泛化的建模約束。<lb/>我們在涵蓋九類優化問題的38個錯誤指定場景上評估我們的方法，其中幾個來自現實世界的應用，並顯示 TACIT 能修復78.9%的場景（相比之下，最佳基準為60.5%）。
